name: LinkedIn Post Scraper
description: Fetch recent LinkedIn posts for entity-linked profiles via the LinkedIn Profile API's Voyager GraphQL endpoint. Modes: posts (default) scrapes post text, engagement metrics, hashtags, mentions, and post type. post_engagers extends posts with who commented and reacted (names, slugs, text, reaction types). Uses the same authenticated Chrome session as linkedin-profile-scraper.
usage_notes: Requires the Profile API (localhost:3847) with an active LinkedIn session. Default mode reads LinkedIn slugs from entity linkedin/linkedin_url field. Set source to 'profile_scraper' to read from linkedin-profile-scraper output instead (requires running that module first). Rate limited to avoid LinkedIn detection.

options.name: mode
options.label: Scraping mode
options.description: posts = fetch post text and engagement counts. post_engagers = fetch posts then fan out to get who commented and reacted on each post.

options.name: posts_per_profile
options.label: Posts per profile
options.description: Number of recent posts to fetch per LinkedIn profile.

options.name: engagers_per_post
options.label: Engagers per post
options.description: Max commenters and reactors to fetch per post (post_engagers mode only). Each post costs 2 extra API calls.

options.name: requests_per_hour
options.label: Requests per hour
options.description: Rate limit for Voyager API calls. Keep conservative (15-30) to avoid detection. In post_engagers mode each post needs 2 extra calls.

options.name: min_word_count
options.label: Min post word count
options.description: Skip posts with fewer words than this (filters image-only or link-only posts).

options.name: source
options.label: Profile source
options.description: Where to find LinkedIn slugs: 'profile_scraper' reads from linkedin-profile-scraper output, 'entity_field' reads from entity linkedin/linkedin_url field.
